body: New town_draw_travel_overlay/g_travel_overlay_text show a brief, large, screen-centered 'TRAVELING: MEADOW'/'TRAVELING: NEW HANDINGTON' banner right at the moment of arrival, the last piece of apps/lobby's own telecrystal UX (draw_travel_overlay/travel_overlay_text) not yet ported over. Distinct from combat_log_push's own arrival line -- a scrolling log entry, easy to miss mid-fight; the banner isn't. Set at both real arrival points (town_telecrystal_travel/town_telecrystal_return), 1.4s duration. Live-verified visually under Xvfb via a direct state-injection test (arrival points require a real logged-in character, unavailable to this session's WOTAN test identity -- same limitation as the earlier fizzle-fix verification). go vet/go test ./... and a direct gcc client build both clean. This completes the apps/lobby telecrystal UX port started earlier today: ring, auto-cast, cast bar, commit marker, and now the arrival banner. GoblinFoxDragon 76b83d0.
title: Telecrystal arrival banner ported from apps/lobby -- reference UX now complete
